summary: Verified new newsletter image upload feature end-to-end. Backend POST /api/upload/image already curl-verified by main agent. Frontend E2E: logged in as admin (email+password+TOTP), navigated to /campaigns/new, dismissed onboarding driver.js tour overlay, added Image block, uploaded a PNG via set_input_files on [data-testid=upload-image-btn-file]; prop-src auto-populated with S3 URL containing '/clara-campaigns/newsletter/', canvas rendered the S3 URL, and public URL fetched HTTP 200 image/png. Same flow verified for Logo block via upload-logo-btn / upload-logo-btn-file. Preview modal (Eye) iframe contains the S3 URL. All acceptance criteria met.

issues: Driver.js onboarding tour overlay intercepts clicks on first visit; users can dismiss it but automation/testing had to remove it. Not a blocker.

critical_code_review_comments: Builder.js is 613 lines - approaching threshold; consider extracting ImageUploader, PropsEditor, renderBlock into separate modules for maintainability.
ImageUploader duplicates the 5MB / image content-type validation already enforced server-side; that's fine for UX but keep in sync if backend limits change.
seed_data_creation: None (uploaded 2 test PNGs to Hetzner S3 under clara-campaigns/newsletter/{company_id}/*.png).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend Builder auto-shows a driver.js tour on first visit. To interact with palette buttons in tests, remove .driver-overlay / .driver-popover elements via page.evaluate before clicking [data-testid=add-block-image] or [data-testid=add-block-logo]. Hidden file inputs use data-testid='upload-image-btn-file' and 'upload-logo-btn-file'. prop-src is shared across block types and updates after upload. Preview modal renders in an iframe within the same page frame tree.
